changes.new_text: A truck-ramming attack was made on the Christmas market at Breitscheidplatz, killing twelve people and injuring 48 others.
changes.new_quote: On 19 December 2016 , at about 20:00 local time , a truck-ramming attack was made on the Christmas market at Breitscheidplatz
